text:
Situation: Ephedrine sulfate 5 mg/mL 10 mL vials (NDC 68083061010, labeled by Gland Pharma Limited) are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 33 vials (6.6 days of supply). Corvale General holds 111 vials (18.6 days of supply).

Why (FDA record): The registered manufacturing plant for this NDC is Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) in India. FDA inspection records show a series of VAI classifications, most recently an inspection ending 2024-07-25 with classification VAI known to FDA on 2025-01-15.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks of coverage. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list and have recent VAI inspection histories.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 27 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires approval by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — requires approval by buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from NorthStar RxLLC — requires approval by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Sandoz Inc — requires approval by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Xiromed, LLC — requires approval by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
